svg.title: Open a Journal, the Instruction Manual, or Editor
svg.desc: In the sidebar, expand Copal for Journal and Editor. The menu beside Journal opens Manage journals. Open Tools, then Instruction Manual, to read the handbook in Editor. Editor's activity rail switches between Text, Wiki, and Graph.

path.aria-label: Open a Journal, the Instruction Manual or Editor
Use the named controls in the sidebar and the Editor activity rail.
The adjacent menu opens Manage journals.
Journal hidden? Settings → Appearance → Copal navigation includes Manage journals.
